comments.author: @MrCuriousES1
comments.text: What stands out about Fiji is that the most interesting idea here has very little to do with beaches or resorts. 🇫🇯 Traditions built around sharing, village life, welcoming strangers and spending time together suggest a very different definition of prosperity. A community can have fewer material resources and still possess forms of social wealth that richer societies sometimes struggle to maintain.
